finance.notice: Estimates, not observed player behavior, actual revenue, fee quotes or approved commercial/accounting policy. Platform fees are modeled separately, not added to browser fees. Aether redemption is not a second sale.

recommendations: This larger package has a worse per-unit rate than the preceding package. Prices remain unchanged pending owner review.
Keep guaranteed first-copy completion at its actual 24-pack bound; forty starting copies still contain thirty unique identities.
Preserve guaranteed individual/collection options. Do not use unfavorable randomness as a revenue policy.
Cosmetics, optional expansions and repeat deck-building can support engagement without combat-stat advantages or artificially delayed founding collection completion.
Prices, sales mix, retention and spending are provisional hypotheses. Measure real cohort behavior before permanent policy decisions.
limitations: No actual purchases, revenue, retention or market prices are inferred.
Premium Monte Carlo values are sample averages against configured singles, not resale value or a guarantee.
Initial premium pools are modeled explicitly; exhaustion, individual choices and trading counterparties change later outcomes.
Gold trajectories reuse the existing objective/mastery model and its disclosed participation assumptions; paying does not alter match power or Gold rules.
An unapproved starter recipe is a forty-copy planning assumption, never authorization to activate deluxe products.
Mobile fees are separate adjustable assumptions; no platform agreement or tax/legal compliance is established.
